issues.descricao: The only change raises the timeout on one visual-test assert from 5s to 15s. The assert itself is unchanged and still checks for 'cancelada', so it is not weaker, and G7 (protected tests) passed. But the cause of the slowness was not investigated: how long the popup-cancel path takes to show the alert in the app. The G6 failures listed in the description (account-delete, account-link, empty-dashboard-regressions) got no code change at all. They now pass, which suggests they were flaky under load and were not fixed.
issues.sugestao: Record a risk in .harness/inbox/risks.jsonl about e2e instability under full-suite load (emulator/parallelism). Check whether the Google popup close detection has a fixed delay or polling in the app. If so, consider making it faster instead of relying on longer test timeouts.
